name: test-once
description: Stop duplicate expensive full-suite runs across Codex sessions, safely reuse exact passing results, and report avoided runs and time.

interface.shortDescription: Run full test suites once and see time saved.
interface.longDescription: Stop development, review, and parallel Codex sessions from rerunning the same expensive full suite. Test Once reuses only passing results matched by exact source, command, environment, platform, and toolchain fingerprints; single-flight locking collapses concurrent runs; focused tests stay untouched; and local statistics show avoided runs and test time. It works with Go, TypeScript, and any shell-driven test suite without telemetry.
defaultPrompt: Configure Test Once for this repository's full test suite.
Run or reuse the configured full test suite safely.
Show how many full-suite runs and seconds Test Once has saved.
